title: Koh Lanta sunsets
sub: Whole west coast faces the sun. Tap a pin, tick the ones you've done.
tip: Sunset is around 6pm, so get there by 5:15 for a good seat. The National Park lighthouse shuts at 5:30, before sunset.

places.name: Sunset Rock & Viewpoint
notes: Quiet rock ledge above the sea, usually just you
Short scramble over rocks. Bring your own drinks

places.name: Klong Khong Restaurant
notes: Book for 4:30 to 5:30pm. Order before the fire show

places.name: LightHouse Beach Bar
notes: Hippie beach bar: chillout before sunset, house after

places.name: Freedom Bar
notes: Reggae, beach lamps, neon inside, fire show

places.name: Pangea Bar & Kitchen
notes: Bamboo bar, DJs, live music Sundays. Party nights Sun and Tue

places.name: Ozone Beach Bar
notes: Sunset into deep house DJ sets
Stick to beer or shakes, cocktails get mixed reviews

places.name: Klong Jak Beach
notes: Quieter beach with mountain backdrop, sunsets rated unreal
Buy a drink at a beach bar to get through

places.name: Kantiang Bay
notes: Big clean bay, gorgeous golden hour
Headland can hide the sun dropping into the sea. Steep road, take a decent scooter
